findings.reason: Verified in RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx: the silence drawer renders only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true, and in the list view rule is undefined while the promRule path enables the Silence item, so clicking it does nothing.

Verified in AlertRuleMenu.tsx: Pause requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) and Delete requires rulerRule, so the promRule-derived abilities never surface these items, and list rows that no longer pass rulerRule lose a Delete they had before this PR.

Confirmed in FilterView.tsx: key is destructured at line 152 and used by sibling branches, but the new GrafanaRuleListItem inside rules.map has no key, causing a React missing-key warning and index-based reconciliation of stateful rows.
The diff clearly removes the returnTo: createReturnTo() from the rule view link href in the list item, a real navigation regression, though its impact is limited to back-navigation behaviour.

Verified the test asserts exactly 4 menu items while delete permission is granted, so it codifies the missing Delete from finding 1 rather than catching it; the hedged Pause claim does not change the core point.
The duplicated per-row hook work is real but is a performance suggestion with no measured or concrete failure, so it is marginal.
